annotations.title: List available job filters and values

description: Returns the facet attributes jobs can be filtered by (for example field, location, job type, seniority level, skills and languages), with the values currently present in active listings and how many listings have each value. The values are the exact strings search_jobs accepts in its `filters` parameter for the same locale. An optional query scopes the values to matching listings. Values are in the language of that query when locale is omitted, or in the given locale.

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language index whose facet values to return: en = English, fi = Finnish, sv = Swedish. When omitted, the language of "query" (detected from it) is used. Values are localized and match search_jobs "filters" verbatim under the same locale.

query.description: Optional free-text query to scope the facet values to a subset of listings (e.g. only the facets present in "nurse" jobs). Leave empty for the whole active index.

name: list_job_filters

facets.description: Values to pass verbatim in search_jobs "filters" with the same locale.
